## 席位核对 — REWORK · head fad5ea01bf81d77231493856df82ff8e7e867087

Read 2026-11-24T20:14Z. L1 of PR #37091 (`Fixes #36716`). The code is right and in scope. One acceptance item on the card was not measured, and `Fixes` closes the card when this merges, so the PR goes back for it.

**Shape / face (`l1-face.mjs --pr 37091`: CLEAN, 13 items).** Open draft against `main`. The first line is `Fixes #36716`, and no closing keyword names any other card. There are 6 files: `.changeset/36716-report-save-custom-overlay.md`, `ReportView.tsx`, `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts` and three `ReportView.*.test.tsx` under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/`. None is outside the card and none is governed. `@object-ui/app-shell` is unpublished, and the one changeset is not empty. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are correct. No published schema, protocol key or acceptance set moves.

**Gates (check-runs at `fad5ea01bf8`).** 38 success, 13 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending. Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check are both `success`. `Type Check · debt ledger`, `Type Check UI` and `Test UI` are `success`. `Test UI` ran the affected plan (slots 1 to 9), which is CI's designed coverage for this diff. `Live E2E UI`, `Build & E2E UI` and `Dogfood Regression Gate` are `success`.

**Diff against card and ADR-0146.**
- `handleOpenBuilder` resolves the target with `resolveInPlaceEditTarget(servedPackageId(reportData))`, the dashboard editor's resolver. A writable owner is saved as `package`. A read-only owner becomes `customization` of `<base>.custom` (D2/D3/D11). `report` is in the overlayable set (ADR-0146 line 98), and a report is an app-edit-state item per D1 as amended 2026-11-24.
- `saveSchema` calls `ensureInPlaceSaveTarget` at Save, which is the first write, so nothing is created at open. A customization body goes through `inPlaceSaveBody`, which declares `overrides { package, basedOn }` through `overrideDraftBody`. `saveInPlace` routes an unbound report to `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata`, as on main.
- The dashboard names in `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts` are now delegating aliases (`= resolveInPlaceEditTarget` and the others). `saveDashboardInPlace` calls `saveInPlace('dashboard', …)`, so the dashboard behaves as before.
- Ablation: replacing `target` with unbound turns the shipped case and the writable control red, and the unbound and refusal cases stay green, as predicted. The restored blob equals HEAD `14ec5897d718`.

**Changeset, read sentence by sentence against the diff.** Every sentence holds:
- the headline (`.custom` instead of 403);
- "wrote every save naming no package" (main's `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata` call without a package);
- "lands where the in-page dashboard editor's does … `overrides: { package, basedOn }`";
- "buffer is still the layered authored read at the package the report is served from";
- the walled and no-version refusals;
- "A report whose package is not listed is refused with the reason";
- "A report that names no package is saved as before".

**Deviations judged.**
- Full app-shell suite not run locally (narrowed to 41 files, 345 tests): accepted. The gate evidence is CI's `Test UI` `success` at this head, and the local union only shows the local subset.
- `check:type-check-debt` NOT MEASURED locally: accepted. `Type Check · debt ledger` is `success` at this head.
- Refusing at open (the editor does not open): this is not a Clause-② narrowing and needs no `(narrowing)` arm. The package is unpublished and no metadata an author can write is refused. It is a UI behaviour change, and the PR body and changeset both state it. It replaces a guaranteed 403 at Save for the read-only case. One case is not stated: a writable-owner report whose package list cannot be read now refuses to open (`resolveInPlaceEditTarget` → `refused`), where main opened it. See nit 2.
- Browser check on `showcase_hours_by_status_chart` NOT MEASURED: **not accepted** (must-fix 1).

### Must-fix

1. **Run the browser check the card's Acceptance names** ("a browser check on the showcase report above") at the head this PR lands on, and post it on the PR or the card. Steps: showcase, admin, open 「按状态统计工时（图表）」 in the report builder, change the chart type, Save. Record three things:
   - the save request goes to `?package=<app>.custom` and is answered 2xx (the publish too);
   - the change is still there after a reload;
   - the frame or network row.

   The tests and the ablation do not cover this, for two reasons. `Fixes` closes #36716, which names this check. And the benefit crosses two server doors that the pin replaces with doubles: the ensure door has to create the pair for this caller, and the write door has to accept a `report` that declares `overrides` into it (l1-review-checklist 〈断言与收益〉, at least one end-to-end check). A unit test cannot show a server-side 403 or 422 there.

### Should-fix (not blocking)

- At open, the buffer and the pending-draft probe are read at the served package. They are never read at the listed pair, where `openDashboardForEdit` reads them first (`target.pair`, with the base as fallback). In ReportView, a Studio draft already pending in the pair is therefore only refused at Save, as `pending-draft` (nothing is written), not at open the way the dashboard refuses it. Either align this with `openDashboardForEdit`, or say in the PR body why reading at the served package is equivalent for reports (`_packageId` per ADR-0150 D5 names the pair once an override is served).

### Nits

1. The `refused` reason is wrapped in the `engine.edit.loadFailed` template ("could not load …"). The walled and no-version refusals use their own sentences, so this one reads as a failed load.
2. The changeset's refusal list does not mention the case where the package list cannot be read.

**L2:** not owed. None of the four contract surfaces is touched (no `Clause-②: yes`, no narrowing, no `packages/spec/src/**`, no governed path), so CI plus this seat read stands, and no `## Contract review` is posted.

**Landing notes for the next round:** no dogfood battery is owed (no `!`, no `(narrowing)`). `landing-k.mjs --pr 37091` CAN'T ANSWER at this head: no Test Core shard ran on this ui-only diff, so no diff base was printed. ⛔ Do not read that as K=0. The seat reads K at landing. Once the browser check is in, this goes back for ACCEPT at that head. The seat can land it (Tier S, not governed).

## Browser check: showcase report saved from the report builder (head bcc7ee84d20)

Read 2026-11-24T22:07Z. This is the check the card's Acceptance names. It answers must-fix 1 of seat record 7143254237.

**Build under test.** This worktree at `bcc7ee84d20aab493ca1df818eed85220c3af833`, the head this PR now carries. The framework closure was built with `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/example-showcase... --filter=@objectstack/cli... --filter=@object-ui/app-shell...` and the Console with `pnpm console:build`. Both ran under the shared verify lock and gave `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The server was `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p 4716` on a fresh file DB with `OS_PORT=4716`. The browser was headless Chromium (Playwright, `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`), signed in as `admin@objectos.ai`.

**Steps.** Open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/report/showcase_hours_by_status_chart` ("Hours by Status (Chart)", served `_packageId: com.example.showcase`, chart `bar`). Click Edit, and the report builder opens. Pick the Line chart, then Save.

**Reading 1: the save goes to the `.custom` pair and is answered 2xx, the publish too.** These are the network rows the page made on Save, as captured:

| method | path | status |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization` | 201 (`created: true`, `packageId: com.example.showcase.custom`, `writable: true`) |
| PUT | `/api/v1/meta/report/showcase_hours_by_status_chart?mode=draft&package=com.example.showcase.custom` | 200 (`Saved customization overlay (env-wide, package=com.example.showcase.custom, state=draft)`, seq 1) |
| POST | `/api/v1/meta/report/showcase_hours_by_status_chart/publish?package=com.example.showcase.custom` | 200 (`Published draft`, seq 2) |

No error toast appeared. Neither server door refused: the ensure door created the pair for this caller, and the write door accepted a `report` that declares `overrides` into it.

**Reading 2: the change persists after a reload.** I navigated to the same URL again. The page draws a line chart, and `GET /api/v1/meta/report/showcase_hours_by_status_chart` serves `chart.type: line` with `overrides: { package: com.example.showcase, basedOn: 0.1.0 }`. I then opened Edit a second time. The builder's chart radios read `line: aria-checked=true` and the others false, so the second edit starts from the first. Switching back to Bar and saving gave ensure-customization 200 (the pair exists now), then PUT `?mode=draft&package=com.example.showcase.custom` 200, then publish 200. The served value was `bar` again.

**Reading 3: the frames.** The runner kept these headless screenshots (local frames, not uploaded):
- `1-builder-line.png`: the builder open, Line selected in CHART, the preview a line plot.
- `3-after-reload.png`: the report page after the reload, a line chart over the same five status rows (Backlog 30, To Do 36, In Progress 100, In Review 54, Done 24; total 244).

The table above is the network row the record asks for.

**Should-fix, checked in the same browser.** I staged a draft of the report in the pair through the API (`PUT ...?mode=draft&package=com.example.showcase.custom` 200) and then clicked Edit. The builder does not open. The toast reads "This item has unpublished changes in com.example.showcase.custom. Publish or discard them in Studio, then edit it here." The page read `GET ...?state=draft&package=com.example.showcase.custom` and got 200. I discarded the staged draft afterwards (DELETE 200).

**Two notes from the run.**
- After the customization is published, the served `_packageId` is still `com.example.showcase`, the base, and not the pair. The layered read at the base already carries the customization in its effective layer (reading 2). So the buffer is still read at the served package, and the open-time pending-draft probe reads the listed pair as `openDashboardForEdit` does. The code comment was corrected to say this. It does not lean on ADR-0150 D5.
- I ran the same three readings at `80022cfa777`, before the comment fix and before the latest merge of `origin/main`. They gave the same rows and statuses.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · head bcc7ee84d20aab493ca1df818eed85220c3af833

Read 2026-11-24T22:12Z. This is the delta round on REWORK 7143254237. It answers the dev report 7145908515 on #36716 and the browser check 7145843007.

**Face and gates.** `l1-face.mjs --pr 37091` is CLEAN at `bcc7ee84d2`. Check-runs: 47 success, 15 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending, `mergeable_state` clean. Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check are both `success`. The diff has 8 files: the earlier 6 plus `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{en,zh}.ts`. Those two carry the keys that nit 1 asked for. `@object-ui/i18n` is published, and the changeset has an entry for it. No path is governed. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are unchanged and correct. Signature on line 1 and `Fixes #36716` on line 2 follow the seat's accepted convention, and the parser reads them as the first line.

**Must-fix 1: closed.** Comment 7145843007 was measured at this head, on a fresh build and a fresh DB, as admin:
- `POST …/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization` answered 201;
- `PUT …?mode=draft&package=com.example.showcase.custom` answered 200;
- `POST …/publish?package=com.example.showcase.custom` answered 200;
- after a reload the served report is `chart.type: line` with `overrides { package, basedOn: 0.1.0 }`;
- the second edit opens with Line checked, and saving it back to Bar answers 200 three times.

Both server doors that the pin replaces with doubles are now shown working end to end.

**Should-fix: closed.** `handleOpenBuilder` now does these steps in order:
1. It resolves the target first.
2. It refuses `refused` and `walled` before any read.
3. It probes the listed pair (`target.pair !== packageId`) with `getDraft`, alongside the served-package reads.
4. It refuses a draft pending in the pair at open, with `engine.studio.customize.pendingDraft`.

The pin covers this: a pending draft in the pair is refused, and a listed pair with no draft opens and saves into the pair. The browser check reproduced the refusal toast.

Why the buffer stays at the served package: the run measured that after publish the served `_packageId` stays the base, and that the base's layered `effective` layer carries the customization. The second edit opening on Line proves it. The code comment was corrected and no longer leans on ADR-0150 D5. I accept this.

**Nits: closed.** The `refused` target now has its own title (`engine.studio.customize.noPackage`), with the reason as the toast description, outside the `loadFailed` template. Both keys are in en and zh.

**Changeset, the new sentences read against the diff.** Every sentence holds:
- "or a draft of the report is already pending in the customization package (the in-page dashboard editor refuses that at open too)";
- "A report whose package is not listed, or whose package list cannot be read, is refused in its own sentence with the reason under it";
- "a report of a writable package opened in the builder before this change even when the list could not be read";
- "Two new Studio sentences carry those refusals in English and Chinese".

The earlier sentences still hold.

**Accepted deviations.**
- The full app-shell suite was not run locally (20 files and 133 tests this round). The evidence is CI's `Test UI` `success` at this head.
- No ablation this round. The save path was ablated at `fad5ea01bf8`, and a case pins the new open-time probe, which the browser also showed.
- `check:type-check-debt` is covered by CI's `Type Check · debt ledger` `success`.
- Refusal at open is a UI behaviour change. The PR body and changeset both state it. It is not a Clause-② narrowing.

**L2:** not owed. None of the four contract surfaces is touched. **Dogfood battery:** not owed (no `!`, no `(narrowing)`). **Landing:** Tier S, not governed, so the seat lands it. `Fixes #36716` closes the card when this merges.
